title: Magic State Distillation via Codes over Binary Extension Fields
summary: Fault-tolerant quantum computation architectures are frequently bottlenecked by the overhead of producing high-fidelity magic states. In this work, we use algebraic geometric techniques to construct codes over binary extension fields $\mathbb{F}_{2^s}$, thus discovering new protocols for the distillation of qubit magic states, where our focus is on the regime of practical qubit-based quantum computing architectures. To do this, we show that multi-qubit gates of interest such as $\text{CS}$, $\text{CCZ}$, and $\text{TOF}\# = \text{CCZ}_{123}\text{CCZ}_{345}$, can be packaged into simple gates…
